systemPrompts.title: Custom system instructions
systemPrompts.description: This prompt is injected at the start of each conversation as a system message.
systemPrompts.defaultPrompt:
You are a skilled professional with experience in technology. ALWAYS respond in FIRST PERSON (I / My / Me). Talk about your experience, projects and skills using your professional profile information. Be conversational, natural and concise. Never repeat the same phrase. If you don't know something, say it once.

Language: English.

tutorial.welcomeDesc: Your intelligent job search assistant. We'll guide you through the main sections.
tutorial.chatDesc: Chat with AI to practice interviews, resolve doubts, and get career advice.
tutorial.jobsDesc: Analyze job postings, generate custom CVs, cover letters, and prepare for interviews.
tutorial.jobSearchDesc: In Jobs, the “Find jobs” tab lets you search LinkedIn listings and import them with one click to analyze them.
tutorial.whatsappDesc: Connect your WhatsApp to automatically detect vacancies in groups and channels and push them into your application flow.
tutorial.interviewDesc: After analyzing a vacancy you can generate CVs in several styles, cover letters and interview questions (downloadable as PDF).
tutorial.statsDesc: View your progress, application metrics and receive advice to improve your profile.
tutorial.browserDesc: Browse job offers inside Aplica, fill forms with your details, attach your CV, and let the AI assistant help you apply.
tutorial.roadmapDesc: Check your personalized career plan with phases, actions, and priorities to boost your career.
tutorial.profileDesc: Complete and update your professional profile with experience, education, projects, and skills.
tutorial.tutorialDesc: You can come back to this guide at any time by clicking here.
tutorial.settingsDesc: Connect your API (Ollama, OpenAI, etc.), customize appearance, and manage your data.
tutorial.automationDesc: Under Settings › Automations you can automate CV and question generation, with confirmation on important steps. You can also edit the prompts of your CV templates.
tutorial.homeDesc: Your daily agenda: upcoming interviews, pending follow-ups, drafts ready to send and your weekly application goal.

friendlyError.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few seconds.
friendlyError.emailAuth: Your email provider rejected the login. Make sure you use an "app password" (not your regular password) and that it was copied correctly.
friendlyError.emailConnection: We couldn't reach your email server. Check your internet connection and email settings.
friendlyError.emailRecipient: The recipient's address doesn't look valid. Check it and try again.
friendlyError.whatsappDisconnected: WhatsApp isn't connected. Link it by scanning the QR code in the WhatsApp section.
friendlyError.whatsappNumber: That number isn't on WhatsApp or is incomplete. Include the country code (e.g. +1).
friendlyError.apiKey: Your AI service key is invalid or expired. Paste it again in Settings.
friendlyError.apiQuota: Your AI account ran out of credit or quota. Check your plan or use another provider.
friendlyError.rateLimit: The AI service got too many requests in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
friendlyError.model: The selected AI model isn't available. Choose another one in Settings.
friendlyError.tooLong: The text is too long for the AI. Try a shorter job post or CV.
friendlyError.aiOffline: We couldn't reach the AI. If you use AI on your computer, make sure Ollama is running.
friendlyError.network: It looks like you're offline. Check your network and try again.
friendlyError.timeout: This took too long. Try again; if it keeps happening, try a faster model.
friendlyError.server: The service is having problems right now. Try again in a few minutes.
friendlyError.badResponse: The AI replied with something we couldn't understand. Please try again.
